ACE gene expression is increased in the aorta and in mesenteric arteries in SHRSP compared with normotensive WKY rats, but ACE activity is not different.

in the aorta of SHRSP rats, ACE gene expression is increased after sodium loading and correlates with ACE activity, whereas in the mesenteric artery, ACE gene expression, but not ACE activity, is increased in SHRSP rats.
ACE is differentially regulated in the aorta and mesenteric arteries from SHRSP compared with Wistar-Kyto rats, in basal conditions and after sodium loading.

the role of ACE in the pathophysiology and regulation of hypertension in SHRSP.
the role of ACE in the pathophysiology, development, and progression of hypertension.

the ACE gene locus may be involved in the pathogenesis of hypertension, but it is not the only genetic factor involved in the development of hypertension in SHRSP, and the role of the ACE gene in the development of salt-induced hypertension in SHRSP remains unclear.
